# auth.register — POST /auth/register

Register a new user

Creates a user. Email must be unique. Does not log in: call `POST /auth/login` to get a token.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.auth.register({ body: { email: "alice@example.com", password: "secret123" } })
res.assert(201)
```

## Input
```ts
{ body: RegisterDto }
```

## Responses
```ts
201: UserDto // The created user. `avatarUrl` is `null`.
400: ErrorDto // Invalid email or password shorter than 6 characters.
409: ErrorDto // A user with this email already exists.
```

## Types
```ts
type RegisterDto = {
  /** Unique email. Used as the login. */
  "email": string
  /** Password, at least 6 characters. */
  "password": string
}
type UserDto = {
  /** User id. */
  "id": number
  /** Email the user registered with. */
  "email": string
  /** Avatar URL. `null` until the user uploads an avatar. */
  "avatarUrl": string | null
}
type ErrorDto = {
  /** HTTP status code. */
  "statusCode": number
  /** Error message. Validation errors (400) return a list: one message per failed constraint. */
  "message": string | Array<string>
  /** HTTP status text, e.g. "Not Found". */
  "error"?: string
}
```
